protocol.independence: P71 and P81 are separate native properties. A state/adaptive patch may contain either alone. Explicit zero/all-false/all-true are retained.
protocol.baseGate: Complete unique default+matched cache chain, determined P71 and P81 with valid carriers; direct object/state entries must also be Overridden. Strict existing Shape0 rectangular saved path or proven ordinary input/textarea/select surface.
protocol.stateGate: Existing local OD filtering and atomic per-state rejection; complete supported base corner pair required. Unknown active values and unresolved inheritance still reject the state.
protocol.adaptiveGate: Explicit local P71/P81 only, complete supported base pair required before local substitution; independent raw source/projection comparison by TS importer. No real adaptive corner-property witnesses in this corpus.
protocol.fallback: Keep saved vector path and existing derived cornerRadii snapshot when parameters cannot be proven. Do not invent cornerVisibility or consume unknown P71/P81.
